holdout.authorized_by: Explicit authorization in issue #1483 is required before unsealing.
holdout.procedure: Only an explicit authorization recorded in issue #1483 may unseal the confirmation after candidate/source/parameters are frozen and the registered development read is accepted. No execution or inspection of per-seed generated truth, partial tables or outcome-driven selection before then. Exactly one confirmation per candidate/slope; any executed confirmation is spent, including an interruption. A failed confirmation stays failed. Redesign requires a new registration and unused confirmation allocation. No resume.
holdout.command:
just bench-day-night --registration tools/bench/day-night-successor.json --run-profile registered --split holdout --policy successor --slope 1.5 --jobs 16 --out successor-registered-holdout-successor-1.5.jsonl
just bench-day-night --registration tools/bench/day-night-successor.json --run-profile registered --split holdout --policy successor --slope 2.0 --jobs 16 --out successor-registered-holdout-successor-2.0.jsonl

calendar.sleep: Sixteen hours on days without a night; eight hours after an eight-hour night. Sleep cools thermal history and is not active exposure. Reference truth uses the same ordered eight-hour daily mix at periodic equilibrium with sixteen-hour sleep; actual trajectory includes preceding nights.

unit_modes.grouping: One tuning unit per CCD, uniform offsets within each CCD, complete physical-core truth/readbacks retained. A per-core policy requires its own later registration; CCD-uniform results cannot establish per-core acceptance.

streams.topology_permutation: Pinned random::stream splitmix64 fold plus Cargo.lock-pinned StdRng. In ascending CCD order shuffle physical-core ids independently using the run seed and successor Limits salt; choose the first four for heterogeneous/refinement, first one for hidden/delayed/combined, none otherwise. Inherited base-edge jitter uses its distinct original Limits salt: integer 0..=2 for edge-shallow, otherwise -1..=1. No per-seed holdout truth is inspected.

continuation.dev_rule: No automatic continuation is registered. On budget expiry retain partial artifacts, return an interruption/error and no gate verdict, then return for an explicit decision. Never cut seeds, scenarios, exposure or horizon; any approved deterministic continuation requires a pre-scoring registration amendment.

notes: LOCAL DRAFT ONLY — NOT FROZEN AND NOT AUTHORIZATION TO SCORE. Merged source revisions, source hashes and implemented commands must be finalized before publication or scoring. No policy result is recorded.

Pending fields: sources.simulator_revision, sources.runner_revision, sources.report_revision, every policies[].source_revision and source_sha256; resolved policy identities must bind the merged sources. Candidate source must use the schema explicit pending form once available, not a fabricated revision. Optional binary/input hashes remain unset until an actual artifact is produced. commands.reduced_dev, commands.registered and holdout.command are draft command lists pending the runner and candidate selectors.

Each catalog-daily-i refers to the exact ith TrialClass returned by the pinned successor Scenario::daily_mix(), preserving order, workload/roles/placement/intended duration and seed-permuted weak-core identity. Four blocks each last 7200 seconds. Definitions and numeric family transformations are the pinned togi-sim catalog, original scenarios/curve and successor exposure implementation, never a generic workload alias.

All criteria are per scenario and slope with no cross-scenario or cross-mode rescue. Missing, duplicate, mismatched, harness-error or truncated cells are INCOMPLETE, never PASS. Complete-unconverged trajectories remain in descriptive safety denominators and fail applicable utility/convergence/retention.

Final admissibility is required on every complete seed. At least 95% must hold every post-first-finish profile in A for its epoch, including retreats, stock transitions and restorations. Each complete seed requires post-finish T>0 and H/T<=lambda. Report exact K/T and one-sided 95% Poisson upper rate only as a model-based diagnostic, not adaptive-policy assurance.

Benign depth requires final A membership and sum depth>=ceil(0.8*M), plus every unit>=min(5,its independently feasible maximum in A intersect E); at least 90% of complete seeds. No-write-limit additionally requires every unit>=44. M is the certified objective over A intersect the fixed depth<=45 envelope; report physical optimum and margin cost separately.

Every scenario needs at least 90% finite final-interval joint settled days<=730; listed benign median<=180 uses every registered seed, infinity for unconverged/truncated, mean of the middle pair for even counts. A later invalidating profile/epoch removes an earlier settled day. At stock-background at least 90% retain every first-finish unit depth minus at most one and remain in A; never-finished fails.

Finished means a policy reason and event witnesses, not blocked/unqualified. Preserve the original all-unit first-finish boundary through firmware. Restoration is both learning and post-finish exposure where applicable, overlapping labels never summed twice. No safety grace after truth or firmware transitions.

D uses step=min(5,ceil((ceiling-current_depth)/2)) with minimum one for a positive gap, one unit per step, after 50 clean hours including before the first step. C=min(U+5,0), censored U=-50 gives C=-45. Exact-profile night qualification and all existing safety/activation/veto checks remain required.

The two-event machine allowance is shared across initial and later refinement phases, never refilled by reset, firmware or mode changes. Provisional CPU-suspect events charge; reclassification retains charge and stop. Consumption is uncapped, remaining=max(2-consumed,0), overspend separate. Unit stops and ceiling finishes are sticky; subdivision never reopens them. Later nonzero profile events remain charged.

Firmware resets to verified stock, requalifies the exact previous whole vector under the new context with current controls, then restores once after 50 clean verified stock hours and remaining allowance. No prior positive-context credit. Restoration is one learning step; CPU-suspect failure undoes it to stock and stops restored units without clearing prior stops or allowance.

Full 730-day trajectories continue collecting events, exposure and retreats after climbing finishes. Keep learning versus post-finish K/T/H, stock background, non-CPU interruptions, night/day failures and unique source/event identities separate. Actual thermal trajectory risk cannot be replaced by the periodic reference rate.

Budgets exclude compilation and apply per one-policy/one-slope invocation with exactly the fixed jobs. Overrun retains partial output and returns for a decision; it never reduces seeds or horizon. Reduced output always carries its exploratory label and cannot issue aggregate gate PASS.

Prominent limitation: zero simulated setup/teardown and omitted physical placement/repeat overhead do not establish real-night feasibility. Hardware acceptance remains separate. No RULESET/SCHEMA switch, per-core candidate acceptance, holdout execution or nonzero deployment is authorized.
